details.name: Glute bridge
details.desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart. Push through your heels to lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line. Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

details.name: Kettlebell swing
details.desc: Feet wider than shoulders, bell on the floor just ahead of you. Hinge, hike the bell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to float it to chest height. The power comes from your hips, not your arms.

details.name: Reverse lunge
details.desc: Hold the bell at your chest. Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor, front shin vertical. Push through the front heel to return, then switch legs.

details.name: Push-up
